background: Citibank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Citigroup, with the broadest international network of any US bank, serving multinationals, institutions and consumers across around a hundred countries.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, with a positive outlook, A+ from S&P and Aa3 from Moody's, both stable. The ratios are strong for a US bank: CET1 of 13.8% is above the 12.1% median, leverage of 7.9% is in the top quarter, and LCR of 117% is at the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is all conduct: the UK sanctions fine reported on 3 Sep 2026, 10 Sep 2026 and 11 Sep 2026, small against the balance sheet but part of a long run of control findings at the group.
